verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region or residency is a fair question for a cloud scraping and data platform like Apify, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any way to pick where datasets or storage live. The proxy and residential-IP items concern the IP location used for scraping, which is an adjacent feature and not data residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
